# Townsquare command line

`townsquare` runs Townsquare (`serve`) and talks to it. Remote commands call a Townsquare server's `/api/v1` with an API key; local commands use this computer's data folder. Every remote command is generated from the API contract, so the CLI, the API and this page always match.

- First steps: `townsquare auth local` (on the Townsquare computer) or `townsquare auth login --url URL --profile NAME < keyfile`, then `townsquare doctor`.
- Machine-readable: `townsquare schema` ([CLI Spec](https://clispec.dev) v0.3), `townsquare <command> --request-schema` / `--response-schema`.
- Agent guide: `townsquare skills show` ([skills/townsquare/SKILL.md](../skills/townsquare/SKILL.md)).
- Settings precedence: flag > environment (`TOWNSQUARE_URL`, `TOWNSQUARE_API_KEY`, `TOWNSQUARE_PROFILE`, `TOWNSQUARE_OUTPUT`) > profile > default (this computer's server).

## Output

`-o auto` (default) prints text on a terminal and JSON when piped. Lists are `{"items": [...], "total": N, "truncated": bool}` (paged lists add `offset`, `limit`, `next_offset`); single records are printed as they are. Data goes to stdout; notes and errors go to stderr. With JSON output, an error is one JSON line on stderr: `{"error": {"kind", "message", "hint", "retryable", "exit_code", "details"}}`.

## Global flags

| Flag | Type | What it does |
|---|---|---|
| `-o`, `--output` | auto \| json \| jsonl \| text \| raw | Output format. auto = text on a terminal, json when piped. raw = the exact API response. |
| `--format-error` | auto \| json \| text | Error format on stderr; auto follows --output |
| `--profile` | string | Saved server and key to use (townsquare profiles list) |
| `--url` | url | Townsquare address, overriding the profile (for example https://townsquare.example.ts.net) |
| `--fields` | string[] | Only these fields (comma list; dotted paths allowed), for records and list items |
| `--transform` | string | Print one value by path, for example items.0.id or items.#.title |
| `--id-only` | boolean | Lists: print only ids |
| `--count` | boolean | Lists: print only the number of matches (server-counted for paged lists) |
| `--limit` | integer | Lists: at most this many (paged on the server) |
| `--offset` | integer | Lists: skip this many |
| `--max-depth` | integer | Collapse nested objects deeper than this |
| `--timeout` | duration | Per-request timeout (and the limit for --wait) |
| `-q`, `--quiet` | boolean | No notes on stderr; stdout carries only data |
| `--dry-run` | boolean | Show what a change would do; send nothing |
| `-y`, `--yes` | boolean | Confirm a command that deletes, sends or restarts (required without a terminal) |
| `--idempotency-key` | string | Make a create or send safe to retry: a repeat with the same key returns the first result |
| `--body` | json | The full request body as JSON, @file.json, or - for stdin; flags override its fields |
| `--deliver` | string | Files (media, CSV, QR codes): stdout or file:PATH |
| `--overwrite` | boolean | Let --deliver file:PATH replace an existing file |
| `--wait` | boolean | Block until linking, an update or a restart finishes (bounded by --timeout) |
| `--request-schema` | boolean | Print the command's request JSON Schema and exit (no network) |
| `--response-schema` | boolean | Print the command's response JSON Schema and exit (no network) |
| `-h`, `--help` | boolean | Help for any command or group |
| `--json` | boolean | Alias of `-o json` |
| `--data` | path | Local commands: the data folder (default `~/.townsquare`) |

## Exit codes

| Code | Kind | Retry? | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| 1 | `general` | no | Unexpected failure inside Townsquare |
| 2 | `usage` | no | Bad command, flag or value (nothing was sent) |
| 2 | `validation` | no | The server rejected the input; the message says what to fix |
| 3 | `auth` | no | No API key, or the key is unknown or revoked |
| 3 | `forbidden` | no | The key's scope is too low for this command |
| 4 | `not_found` | no | No such post, tag, chat or other record |
| 5 | `conflict` | no | The request conflicts with the current state (for example nothing to undo) |
| 6 | `confirmation_required` | no | A command that changes or sends things needs --yes without a terminal |
| 7 | `network` | yes | Townsquare can't be reached (wrong --url, or it isn't running) |
| 7 | `unavailable` | yes | Townsquare is up but WhatsApp or Telegram isn't connected, or the update server can't be reached |
| 8 | `rate_limit` | yes | Too many requests; wait for the given time |
| 9 | `busy` | yes | A post is due within 15 minutes, so a restart or update waits |
| 10 | `timeout` | yes | No answer in time (--timeout) |
| 11 | `uncertain_outcome` | no | A request that creates or sends something timed out; it may or may not have happened |
| 20 | `due_soon` (outcome) | n/a | `townsquare due`: a post is due within the window (the list is on stdout). Not an error. |
| 21 | `unhealthy` (outcome) | n/a | `townsquare doctor`: at least one check failed (the report is on stdout). Not an error. |

## Remote commands

Effects: `read_only` changes nothing; `idempotent` is safe to repeat; `non_idempotent` creates or sends something, so pass `--idempotency-key` to retry safely. Commands marked **needs --yes** refuse without a terminal unless `--yes` is given; preview them with `--dry-run`.

### changelog

Release notes.

#### `townsquare changelog list`

Get release notes. `GET /api/v1/changelog` · read_only

- `--from` string Exclusive, e.g. v0.6.0
- `--to` string Inclusive

```sh
townsquare changelog list --from v0.6.0
```

### clients

Group posts and chats by client.

#### `townsquare clients create`

Create client. `POST /api/v1/clients` · non_idempotent

- `--color` string 
- `--name` string 
- `--quiet-end` string 
- `--quiet-start` string 
- `--timezone` string 

```sh
townsquare clients create --name 'Riverside Center' --color '#2DB34E'
```

#### `townsquare clients delete ID`

Delete client. `DELETE /api/v1/clients/{id}` · idempotent · **needs --yes**

```sh
townsquare clients delete 2 --yes
```

#### `townsquare clients list`

List clients. `GET /api/v1/clients` · read_only

```sh
townsquare clients list --fields id,name,quiet_start,quiet_end
```

#### `townsquare clients update ID`

Update client. `PATCH /api/v1/clients/{id}` · idempotent

- `--color` string 
- `--name` string 
- `--quiet-end` string 
- `--quiet-start` string 
- `--timezone` string 

```sh
townsquare clients update 2 --quiet-start 22:00 --quiet-end 06:00 --timezone America/New_York
```

### posts

Create, schedule, edit, pause and send posts.

#### `townsquare posts bulk`

Bulk update posts. `POST /api/v1/posts/bulk` · non_idempotent · **needs --yes**

- `--action` string (required) One of: pause, resume, draft, archive, delete, tag, client, add_targets, remove_targets. 
- `--client-id` integer 
- `--ids` integer list (required) 
- `--tag-id` integer 
- `--targets` string list For add_targets/remove_targets: JIDs or names

```sh
townsquare posts bulk --body '{"ids":[41,42],"action":"pause"}' --yes
```

#### `townsquare posts create`

Create post. `POST /api/v1/posts` · non_idempotent

- `--caption` string WhatsApp markup allowed: *bold* _italic_ ~strike~ ```mono```
- `--client-id` integer 
- `--media` integer list Media ids from POST /media; each is sent as its own message, caption on the first
- `--schedules` object list 
- `--send-at` string Shortcut for one send: RFC 3339, or local YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM in tz
- `--status` string One of: draft, scheduled, paused, archived. Default: draft (even with a time). Set scheduled to send.
- `--tag-id` integer 
- `--targets` string list JIDs, exact chat names, "me" or "status"
- `--title` string 
- `--tz` string Zone for send_at and schedules without tz. Default: the app's time zone

```sh
townsquare posts create --title 'Family dinner' --caption @dinner.txt --targets 'Main Group,Youth Group' --send-at 2026-10-15T18:30 --dry-run
townsquare posts create --body @post.json --idempotency-key dinner-2026-10-15
```

#### `townsquare posts delete ID`

Delete post. `DELETE /api/v1/posts/{id}` · idempotent · **needs --yes**

- `--scope` string One of: all, one, future. 
- `--schedule-id` integer 
- `--occ` string 

```sh
townsquare posts delete 42 --dry-run
townsquare posts delete 42 --scope one --schedule-id 51 --occ 2026-10-15T18:30 --yes
```

#### `townsquare posts duplicate ID`

Duplicate post. `POST /api/v1/posts/{id}/duplicate` · non_idempotent

```sh
townsquare posts duplicate 42
```

#### `townsquare posts get ID`

Get post. `GET /api/v1/posts/{id}` · read_only

```sh
townsquare posts get 42
townsquare posts get 42 --max-depth 1
```

#### `townsquare posts list`

List posts. `GET /api/v1/posts` · read_only · paged

- `--status` string list One of: draft, scheduled, paused, archived. Comma list
- `--tag-id` string 
- `--client-id` string 
- `--target` string JID
- `--q` string Title or caption contains

```sh
townsquare posts list --status scheduled --limit 10 --fields id,title,next_at
townsquare posts list --q 'bake sale' --id-only
```

#### `townsquare posts pause ID`

Pause post. `POST /api/v1/posts/{id}/pause` · idempotent

```sh
townsquare posts pause 42
```

#### `townsquare posts preview`

Preview post. `POST /api/v1/posts/preview` · read_only

- `--caption` string WhatsApp markup allowed: *bold* _italic_ ~strike~ ```mono```
- `--client-id` integer 
- `--media` integer list Media ids from POST /media; each is sent as its own message, caption on the first
- `--schedules` object list 
- `--send-at` string Shortcut for one send: RFC 3339, or local YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM in tz
- `--status` string One of: draft, scheduled, paused, archived. Default: draft (even with a time). Set scheduled to send.
- `--tag-id` integer 
- `--targets` string list JIDs, exact chat names, "me" or "status"
- `--title` string 
- `--tz` string Zone for send_at and schedules without tz. Default: the app's time zone

```sh
townsquare posts preview --body @post.json
```

#### `townsquare posts resume ID`

Resume post. `POST /api/v1/posts/{id}/resume` · idempotent

```sh
townsquare posts resume 42
```

#### `townsquare posts send-now ID`

Send post now. `POST /api/v1/posts/{id}/send-now` · non_idempotent · **needs --yes**

```sh
townsquare posts send-now 42 --dry-run
townsquare posts send-now 42 --yes
```

#### `townsquare posts upcoming ID`

List upcoming sends of a post. `GET /api/v1/posts/{id}/sends` · read_only

- `--n` integer 

```sh
townsquare posts upcoming 42 --n 5
```

#### `townsquare posts update ID`

Update post. `PATCH /api/v1/posts/{id}` · idempotent

- `--at` string scope=one: new local time for this send
- `--at-tz` string Zone of at; default the app's zone
- `--caption` string WhatsApp markup allowed: *bold* _italic_ ~strike~ ```mono```
- `--client-id` integer 
- `--media` integer list Media ids from POST /media; each is sent as its own message, caption on the first
- `--occ` string With scope one/future: the send's original local time (from GET /sends)
- `--schedule-id` integer With scope one/future: the schedule of the send
- `--schedules` object list 
- `--scope` string One of: all, one, future. Repeating posts: which sends to change. Default all
- `--send-at` string Shortcut for one send: RFC 3339, or local YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM in tz
- `--status` string One of: draft, scheduled, paused, archived. Default: draft (even with a time). Set scheduled to send.
- `--tag-id` integer 
- `--targets` string list JIDs, exact chat names, "me" or "status"
- `--title` string 
- `--tz` string Zone for send_at and schedules without tz. Default: the app's time zone

```sh
townsquare posts update 42 --caption @dinner.txt --scope all
townsquare posts update 42 --status scheduled --dry-run
```

### sends

Single sends on the calendar: list, move, copy, skip.

#### `townsquare sends copy`

Copy send. `POST /api/v1/sends/copy` · non_idempotent

- `--occ` string (required) 
- `--post-id` integer (required) 
- `--schedule-id` integer (required) 
- `--scope` string One of: one, all. 
- `--to` string New local YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM
- `--tz` string Zone of to

```sh
townsquare sends copy --post-id 42 --schedule-id 51 --occ 2026-10-15T18:30 --to 2026-10-22T18:30
```

#### `townsquare sends deliveries`

List deliveries of a send. `GET /api/v1/sends/deliveries` · read_only

- `--schedule-id` integer (required) 
- `--occ` string (required) 

```sh

```

#### `townsquare sends list`

List sends. `GET /api/v1/sends` · read_only

- `--from` string YYYY-MM-DD or RFC 3339
- `--to` string 
- `--post-id` string 

```sh
townsquare sends list --from 2026-10-12 --to 2026-10-19 --fields items
```

#### `townsquare sends move`

Move send. `POST /api/v1/sends/move` · non_idempotent

- `--occ` string (required) 
- `--post-id` integer (required) 
- `--schedule-id` integer (required) 
- `--scope` string One of: one, all. 
- `--to` string New local YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM
- `--tz` string Zone of to

```sh
townsquare sends move --post-id 42 --schedule-id 51 --occ 2026-10-15T18:30 --to 2026-10-15T19:00 --scope one
```

#### `townsquare sends skip`

Skip send. `POST /api/v1/sends/skip` · idempotent

- `--occ` string (required) 
- `--post-id` integer (required) 
- `--schedule-id` integer (required) 
- `--scope` string One of: one, all. 
- `--to` string New local YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM

```sh

```

### stats

Reach, reads, reactions and replies.

#### `townsquare stats badges`

Get calendar badges. `GET /api/v1/stats/badges` · read_only

- `--from` string YYYY-MM-DD
- `--to` string YYYY-MM-DD

```sh

```

#### `townsquare stats export`

Download stats as CSV. `GET /api/v1/stats/export.csv` · read_only · writes text/csv (`--deliver`)

- `--days` integer 7, 30 (default) or 90; any 1 to 366
- `--to` string Last day, YYYY-MM-DD (default today)
- `--platform` string Comma list: whatsapp,telegram
- `--tag` string Comma list of tag ids; 0 = no tag
- `--client` string Comma list of client ids; 0 = no client
- `--chat` string Comma list of chat jids

```sh
townsquare stats export --days 90 --deliver file:./stats.csv
```

#### `townsquare stats post ID`

Get post engagement. `GET /api/v1/stats/posts/{id}` · read_only

- `--schedule-id` integer One series
- `--occ` string One send (with schedule_id)

```sh
townsquare stats post 42 --max-depth 1
```

#### `townsquare stats share`

Send summary to a chat. `POST /api/v1/stats/share` · non_idempotent · **needs --yes**

- `--days` integer 7, 30 (default) or 90; any 1 to 366
- `--to` string Last day, YYYY-MM-DD (default today)
- `--platform` string Comma list: whatsapp,telegram
- `--tag` string Comma list of tag ids; 0 = no tag
- `--client` string Comma list of client ids; 0 = no client
- `--chat` string Comma list of chat jids
- `--to` string "me" (default, your own chat) or a chat jid. Safe mode limits this to allowlisted chats.

```sh
townsquare stats share --days 7 --to me --yes
```

#### `townsquare stats summary`

Get engagement summary. `GET /api/v1/stats/summary` · read_only

- `--days` integer 7, 30 (default) or 90; any 1 to 366
- `--to` string Last day, YYYY-MM-DD (default today)
- `--platform` string Comma list: whatsapp,telegram
- `--tag` string Comma list of tag ids; 0 = no tag
- `--client` string Comma list of client ids; 0 = no client
- `--chat` string Comma list of chat jids


Get summary as text. `GET /api/v1/stats/summary.txt` · read_only · writes text/plain (`--deliver`)

- `--days` integer 7, 30 (default) or 90; any 1 to 366

- `--starred` boolean 

```sh
townsquare targets update 120363000000000102@g.us --client-id 2
townsquare targets update 120363000000000102@g.us --allowed true --dry-run
```

### telegram

Link Telegram, the bot and the app id.

#### `townsquare telegram app reset`

Use the shared Telegram app id. `DELETE /api/v1/telegram/app` · idempotent · **needs --yes**

```sh
townsquare telegram app reset --yes
```

#### `townsquare telegram app set`

Use your own Telegram app id. `POST /api/v1/telegram/app` · idempotent

- `--api-hash` string (required) Secret: pass `@file` or `@-`. 
- `--api-id` string (required) 

```sh
townsquare telegram app set --api-id 1234567 --api-hash @api_hash.txt
```

#### `townsquare telegram bot remove`

Remove Telegram bot token. `DELETE /api/v1/telegram/bot` · idempotent · **needs --yes**

```sh
townsquare telegram bot remove --yes
```

#### `townsquare telegram bot set`

Set Telegram bot token. `PUT /api/v1/telegram/bot` · idempotent

- `--token` string (required) Secret: pass `@file` or `@-`. 

```sh
townsquare telegram bot set --token @bot_token.txt
```

#### `townsquare telegram get`

Get Telegram status. `GET /api/v1/telegram` · read_only

```sh
townsquare telegram get
```

#### `townsquare telegram login`

Start Telegram QR login. `POST /api/v1/telegram/login` · idempotent

```sh
townsquare telegram login
```

#### `townsquare telegram logout`

Log out of Telegram. `POST /api/v1/telegram/logout` · idempotent · **needs --yes**

```sh
townsquare telegram logout --yes
```

#### `townsquare telegram password`

Send Telegram two-step password. `POST /api/v1/telegram/password` · non_idempotent

- `--password` string (required) Secret: pass `@file` or `@-`. 

```sh
printf '%s' "$TG_PASSWORD" | townsquare telegram password --password @-
```

#### `townsquare telegram qr`

Telegram login QR code. `GET /api/v1/telegram/qr.png` · read_only · writes image/png (`--deliver`)

```sh
townsquare telegram qr --deliver file:./telegram-qr.png
```

#### `townsquare telegram refresh`

Refresh Telegram chats. `POST /api/v1/telegram/refresh` · idempotent

```sh
townsquare telegram refresh
```

### test

Send a test to yourself.

#### `townsquare test send`

Test send to yourself. `POST /api/v1/test-send` · non_idempotent

- `--caption` string 
- `--media` integer list 
- `--platform` string One of: whatsapp, telegram. 

```sh
townsquare test send --caption 'Testing the Friday digest' --platform whatsapp
```

### whatsapp

Link or unlink WhatsApp; create channels.

#### `townsquare whatsapp channels create`

Create a WhatsApp channel. `POST /api/v1/whatsapp/channels` · non_idempotent

- `--description` string 
- `--name` string (required) 

```sh
townsquare whatsapp channels create --name 'Riverside Updates' --description 'News from the center'
```

#### `townsquare whatsapp get`

Get WhatsApp link status. `GET /api/v1/whatsapp` · read_only

```sh
townsquare whatsapp get
```

#### `townsquare whatsapp link`

Start linking WhatsApp. `POST /api/v1/whatsapp/link` · idempotent

- `--phone` string Optional, with country code, for a typed pairing code

```sh
townsquare whatsapp link --phone 15551234567
```

#### `townsquare whatsapp logout`

Unlink WhatsApp. `POST /api/v1/whatsapp/logout` · idempotent · **needs --yes**

```sh
townsquare whatsapp logout --yes
```

#### `townsquare whatsapp qr`

WhatsApp link QR code. `GET /api/v1/whatsapp/qr.png` · read_only · writes image/png (`--deliver`)

```sh
townsquare whatsapp qr --deliver file:./whatsapp-qr.png
```

## Setup and inspection

- `townsquare doctor`: Check everything an agent needs: server, key, versions, WhatsApp, Telegram, safe mode, what's due. Exits 21 (outcome unhealthy) when a check fails. (read_only)
- `townsquare agenda`: What goes out in the next hours: each send with its post and chats (read_only)
- `townsquare auth login`: Save a server and key as a profile. The key comes from stdin or TOWNSQUARE_API_KEY, never a flag. (idempotent)
- `townsquare auth status`: Check the key against the server without changing anything. (read_only)
- `townsquare auth logout`: Forget a profile's key. (idempotent)
- `townsquare auth local`: On the Townsquare computer: create a key in its database and save the profile "local". (non_idempotent)
- `townsquare profiles list`: Saved profiles (no secrets). (read_only)
- `townsquare profiles get`: One profile (no secrets). (read_only)
- `townsquare profiles use`: Make a profile the default. (idempotent)
- `townsquare profiles remove`: Delete a profile and its key. (idempotent)
- `townsquare context`: Which server, profile and key this shell uses, and where each came from (read_only)
- `townsquare schema`: Every command as JSON (CLI Spec v0.3); `schema posts list` narrows it; --validate checks it (read_only)
- `townsquare skills list`: Agent guides shipped with this version. (read_only)
- `townsquare skills show`: Print an agent guide (SKILL.md). (read_only)
- `townsquare skills path`: Write the guides to a folder and print where (for agents that install skills from files). (idempotent)
- `townsquare feedback`: Record CLI friction locally (~/.config/townsquare/feedback.jsonl). No network. (non_idempotent)
- `townsquare feedback list`: Show recorded feedback. (read_only)
- `townsquare help`: Help for any command: help posts create (read_only)

## Local commands

These use this computer's data folder (`--data`) and need no server or key.

- `townsquare apikey`: Create, list or revoke API keys in this computer's database (the first admin key comes from here). Example: `townsquare apikey create isla-agent --scope write`
- `townsquare autostart`: Start Townsquare when you log in (LaunchAgent, systemd user service or Run key): on, off, or show. Example: `townsquare autostart`
- `townsquare config`: Show or set this computer's server address and tailnet name (config.json). Restart to apply. Example: `townsquare config`
- `townsquare due`: List sends due within a window either side of now. Exits 20 (outcome due_soon) when any are due. Example: `townsquare due`
- `townsquare login-link`: Print a one-time sign-in link for the web app (works once, 15 minutes). Example: `townsquare login-link --base https://townsquare.example.ts.net`
- `townsquare pair`: Link WhatsApp from a terminal (QR code, or a code for your phone number). Stop the server first. Example: `townsquare pair`
- `townsquare serve`: Run the Townsquare server: web app, API and send loop. Example: `townsquare serve`
- `townsquare update`: Download the newest signed release for this computer (used from the next start). Never runs on its own. Example: `townsquare update --check`
- `townsquare version`: Print the version. Example: `townsquare version`
